title: Vikramarkudu
desc: When Sathi Babu, a thief, finds a little girl who claims him as her father, his life changes.

title: Yamadonga
desc: Raja, an orphan whose dream is to become rich, falls in love with his childhood friend Mahi. However, he gets killed by her uncles and is sent to hell, where he creates havoc.

title: Magadheera
desc: A kind-hearted young man falls in love with a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside down after learning about his relationship with the woman from a previous birth.

title: Maryadha Ramanna
desc: Ramu returns to his hometown to sell a piece of land he owns and falls in love with a young woman only to discover that her parents want him dead.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, both of whom once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces against despotic rulers.

title: Raju Gari Gadhi 3
desc: Ashwin and Maya, a couple in love, learn of the presence of an evil spirit in their life. Determined to bring their life back to normalcy, Ashwin sets out on a spooky journey to safeguard his love.

title: Chandrakala
desc: A family moves into their ancestral mansion to try to sell it off. However, trouble starts brewing when they experience supernatural phenomena and a ghost mysteriously killing people.

title: Anukokunda Oka Roju
desc: Sahasra, a struggling singer, attends a party and wakes up with amnesia. However, as the days pass, she realises something is amiss after getting chased by men who want to kill her.

title: Keedaa Cola
desc: A hapless yet hilarious group hatches a get-rich-quick scheme by planting a cockroach in a soft drink bottle. But will their outrageous plan lead to fortune or total disaster?

title: Naa Saami Ranga
desc: A man gains great notoriety in his village for his unmatched strength and brutal nature, which makes him a target of antisocial elements with a ruthless agenda.

title: Bheemla Nayak
desc: A battle begins between SI Bheemla Nayak, a righteous policeman, and Daniel Shekhar, an ex-havildar, when Daniel tricks Bheemla into surrendering to corruption.

title: Saamy 2
desc: Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.

title: Mr. Bachchan
desc: Suspended for his honesty, an income tax officer returns to his hometown to live with his family. However, he is soon reinstated and tasked with raiding the home of a corrupt politician.

title: War 2
desc: Things get complicated when Kabir Dhaliwal, a secret agent, is accused of betraying his nation and his former batchmate shoulders the responsibility of finding him.
